faqs.a:
Subject to the limitations in Charter, section
5.7
, administrative rules or regulations governing administrative procedures and the
               application of a law to the public may be adopted to aid in the administration and
               enforcement of ordinances pursuant to the procedure set forth in this article. Provided,
               however, the procedure contained herein shall not apply to adoption of rules by the
               Arvada Municipal Court.
(Code 1960, § 2-50; Code 1981, § 2-121)
Charter reference—
Action by ordinance required, §
5.7
.
